functionalRequirement: Customers shall be able to search for new products in the database by entering item names, and upon successful search, view detailed product information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The product search functionality shall return relevant results for at least 95% of valid product name queries, including partial matches and common misspellings.
identifiedNFRs.justification: This ensures the search function effectively fulfills its core purpose of finding products based on customer input.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The product search shall return results within 2 seconds for 95% of queries, even during peak loads of up to 1000 concurrent users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Fast search response is critical for customer satisfaction when searching for products.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The product detail view shall load all information (images, specifications, pricing) within 3 seconds for 90% of requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Customers need timely access to product details after performing a search to make purchase decisions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The search interface shall provide auto-suggestions after the user types 3 or more characters, with suggestions appearing within 500ms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Auto-suggestions enhance the search experience by helping customers find products more easily.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The product detail view shall present information in a consistent layout with critical details (price, availability, specifications) visible without scrolling on standard desktop and mobile viewports.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Consistent and accessible presentation of product information improves the customer experience after search.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The search functionality shall maintain 99.9% availability during business hours and 99.5% during non-business hours.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Search is a core customer-facing function that requires high availability to ensure customer satisfaction.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The search function shall sanitize all user inputs to prevent SQL injection and cross-site scripting attacks, with 100% of inputs validated before processing.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Search functionality involves user input that could be exploited if not properly secured.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The search functionality shall be implemented as a separate service module with defined APIs, allowing for updates without affecting other system components.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Modular implementation enables easier maintenance and updates to the search functionality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The search system shall be able to scale to handle a 200% increase in product database size without degradation in performance.
identifiedNFRs.justification: As the product catalog grows, the search functionality must maintain its performance levels.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow users to search for suggested doctors for consultation based on their symptoms or predicted diseases.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The doctor recommendation system shall match users with appropriate specialists with at least 90% relevance based on symptoms or diseases entered.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The core function requires accurate matching between medical conditions and appropriate medical specialists.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The doctor search functionality shall return results within 3 seconds for 95% of queries, even during peak usage periods.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Users seeking medical consultation need timely recommendations, especially in potential emergency situations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The doctor search functionality shall be compatible with all major browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) and mobile platforms (iOS, Android) with the same level of functionality.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Users may need to search for doctors across different devices and platforms, particularly in urgent situations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The symptom input interface shall provide auto-complete suggestions from a standardized medical terminology database after typing 2 or more characters.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Medical terminology can be complex; auto-complete helps users accurately describe their conditions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The doctor recommendation results shall display key information (specialty, experience, availability, location) in a consistent format that requires no more than one click to access detailed profiles.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Users need clear, accessible information to make informed decisions about which doctor to consult.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The doctor search system shall maintain 99.95% uptime, with scheduled maintenance only during off-peak hours (2 AM - 4 AM local time).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Medical consultations may be needed at any time, requiring high availability of the search function.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: All symptom and disease information entered by users shall be encrypted in transit and at rest using industry-standard encryption (TLS 1.3 and AES-256).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Medical information is highly sensitive personal data requiring strong protection.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall implement role-based access controls ensuring that only authorized healthcare providers can view detailed user symptom information.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Medical privacy regulations require strict access controls for patient health information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The medical terminology and doctor database shall be updateable without system downtime, with changes reflected in search results within 15 minutes of updates.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Medical information and doctor availability change frequently, requiring easy maintenance.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall clearly indicate that doctor recommendations are not a substitute for emergency care, with prominent warnings for symptoms that suggest immediate medical attention is required.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Patient safety requires clear guidance about the limitations of the recommendation system in emergency situations.
